text:
nico: Quick quirky poll  crunchy snacks vs quiet keys. Pick one combo or add a wildcard. Options: 1) Vim + pretzels (crunchy) 2) VSCode + almond butter toast (moderate) 3) Neovim + quiet tea biscuits (silent) 4) Emacs + carrot sticks (healthy & crunchy) 
tara: 3) Neovim + quiet tea biscuits. I genuinely prefer no crumbs in switches. :shushing_face: 
ben: 1) Vim + pretzels. Crunch is focus. :pretzel: 
anya: 2) VSCode + almond butter toast. Protein keeps me steady. :bread: :peanuts: 
swag-bot: Poll created  React with 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ 4️⃣ to vote. Reminder: keep food away from shared keyboards. :keyboard:
nico: quick manual tally so far:
```
1: ben
2: anya
3: tara
4: (none)
```
tara: note for the record: tea biscuits > pretzels for long debugging sessions. Also napkin enforcement. :tea:
ben: @tara blasphemy but fine. if pretzels win i'll sponsor a bag for the kitchen. :money_with_wings: 
nico: poll closes in 2 hours. winner gets a tiny sticker mockup idea: "Crunch Responsibly" with a crossed keyboard and pretzel. Thoughts? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
